# BitwellForge

> BitwellForge builds commercial growth architecture for agencies, consultants, and B2B service businesses: client acquisition, revenue systems, positioning, and AI-powered operations engineered to compound.

BitwellForge is a revenue infrastructure consultancy. Engagements begin with an infrastructure audit, then move through diagnosis, system design, build, activation, and optimisation.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Commercial growth architecture, engagement formats, and results overview.
- [About](/about): Firm philosophy, core architecture, and the belief behind the work.
- [Services](/services): Revenue infrastructure modules across strategy, acquisition, conversion, authority, automation, and product.
- [Process](/process): How infrastructure gets built, stage by stage.
- [Case Studies](/case-studies): Concept studies showing system design and projected outcomes.
- [Insights](/insights): Strategic intelligence library on growth systems, pipeline design, and positioning.
- [Careers](/careers): Open roles and the application process.
- [Forge Vault](/forge-vault): The Commercial Growth System product.
- [Affiliate Program](/affiliate): Partner and referral program overview.
- [Contact](/contact): Book an infrastructure audit or open a discovery conversation.
